mapper.insert: insert into refresh_token (jti, user_id, issued_at, expires_at, revoked) values (#{jti}, #{userId}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{revoked})

update refresh_token set revoked = 1 where user_id = #{userId} and revoked = 0
